extracted text: The paper describes the synthesis of germanosilicate type CDS-1 zeolite with CDO topology and its layered precursor [Ge]PLS-1. For [Ge]PLS-1 synthesis, the gel composition was 1.0 SiO2:x GeO2:0.30 TMAOH:5.0 H2O, where x was 0–0.1 (equivalent to Si/Ge ratios from infinity to 10). Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAOH) was used as an organic structure-directing agent. The hydrothermal treatment was carried out for 3 days at 170 °C. The [Ge]CDS-1 zeolite was prepared by calcination of [Ge]PLS-1 at 500 °C for 6 h (heating rate was 0.5 °C/min) under air flow (100 mL/min). The synthesis used H-kanemite (H2Si2O5) as the silica source and GeO2 as the germanium source.

PLS-1 - Layered silicate precursor
CDS-1 - Condensed Disordered Structure type 1 (zeolite with CDO topology)
ratio calculations:
The gel composition is given as 1.0 SiO2:x GeO2:0.30 TMAOH:5.0 H2O where x varies from 0 to 0.1.
For Si: Since SiO2 = 1.0, Si = 1.0
For Ge: Ge = x where x varies from 0 to 0.1
For OH: OH is contained in TMAOH (ratio 0.30), so OH = 0.30
For H2O: H2O = 5.0
For OSDA (TMAOH): osda_ratio = 0.30
